note:
Stage 3: small-signal impedance sweep, 0.2 A peak, 100 log points 100 Hz - 100 kHz
(25 points on 2026-11-05).

Per point: amplitude 0 at f -> ramp (<= 25 %/step) -> at ~0.5x target, 5 acquisitions
triggered on the generator start (AWG_PE; restarts the sine at phase 0, step <= 0.5x target)
give MON and current phase vs OUT1 -> ramp to target, trim to 0.2 A, 5 free-running
acquisitions (lock-in) -> ramp down.
